description: Attach a custom domain you own to an agent to serve your live tunnel OR a published miniapp over HTTPS. Returns the DNS TXT record for ownership verification and the A record target pointing to the Caddy edge for automatic on-demand TLS.

agent_id.description: The agent to bind the domain to — you must control it

domain.description: The hostname, e.g. agents.example.com (no scheme, port or path)

name: connect_domain
title: Connect custom domain
